name: TownCenter
description: Starting building. Trains Workers, is the drop-off point for gathered resources and gives +25 population capacity. If your Town Center is destroyed you lose the match.

name: House
description: Cheap building that raises the population cap by +5. Build Houses before the population limit blocks unit training.

name: Barracks
description: Military building required to train Spearmen and Archers (Marines and Snipers in Sci-Fi). Training queue holds up to 5 units.

name: Stable
description: Required to train Cavalry (Tanks in Sci-Fi). Training queue holds up to 5 units.

name: Blacksmith
description: Research building. All Weapon, Armor and Wall upgrades are researched here, one research at a time. If it is destroyed during research, the research is cancelled and refunded.

name: Mine
description: Gold-only building that produces +10 gold every 10 seconds while one Worker is assigned inside it (max 1 worker). The worker inside is hidden and cannot be attacked.

name: DefenseTower
description: Defensive tower bought with gold only. It must be manned by one soldier (an Archer in Medieval, a Marine in Sci-Fi) to fire. Archer Tower: 12 damage, range 6.5, every 1.6 s. Rocket Turret: 30 damage, range 7, every 3 s. Only Archers can attack an enemy Archer Tower; only Tanks can attack an enemy Rocket Turret.

name: Wall
description: 1x1 wall segment, 10 wood each, drawn by dragging. Health depends on the wall upgrade tier: Medieval Wood/Stone/Brick = 300/600/1000 HP, Sci-Fi Cement/Iron/Obsidian = 450/900/1500 HP. Upgrading also upgrades existing walls.

name: Farm
description: Farm plot, 10 wood per cell. Workers plant it, it grows for about 45 seconds and the harvest returns three times the food spent on planting (net 2x profit). Idle workers nearby farm automatically.
